prompts.prompt: Create a production 2D sprite sheet with EXACTLY EIGHT frames in TWO COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS. Canvas landscape 1536x1024; each cell is a VERY WIDE 768x256 animation canvas, so the frames are spaced far apart horizontally. The figure is only around 200 pixels tall within each cell, centered at x=384 relative to that cell, with feet baseline at y=235. Keep at least 160 pixels horizontal empty space to each cell edge, so fully stretched arms/blades stay inside the frame. This sparse wide-cell layout is intentional. Read order row-major: 0 top-left,1 top-right,2 second-row-left,3 second-row-right,4 third-row-left,5 third-row-right,6 bottom-left,7 bottom-right. Each pose has the SAME body size and ground level, all parts uncropped, no body scaling between poses. Genuine TRANSPARENT background (alpha 0), no white or brown matte, no background gradient, fog, drop shadow, ground, captions, borders, numbers, text, or checkerboard picture. Character interiors remain solid opaque with the SAME muted colors, subtle pigment texture, shadows and costume details as the selected character in the reference. Match the moderately thinner hand-drawn outlines, not the paper background. Preserve exact head/body proportions and identity. Eight distinct drawings for a continuous ATTACK: 0 original idle,1 knees bend and weight moves back,2 weapon/arm winds up,3 strong anticipation,4 forward contact strike,5 follow-through,6 partial recovery,7 original idle. Articulated elbows/shoulders/hips and cloth follow-through; not eight translated copies. The weapon can extend left/right inside its very wide cell. Do not put 4 or 8 figures in one row: ONLY TWO FIGURES PER ROW, FOUR ROWS. ONLY the LEFT HUMAN SURVIVOR. Facing RIGHT. Tan ochre pointed hood/poncho, gray scarf, brown square backpack and pouch, gray-olive trousers, forearm wraps, brown work boots, same short blade in right hand. ATTACK is a forward blade thrust matching the four bottom reference poses. Retain all original colors, texture and silhouette. No other characters.
